beans.title: Lemony white beans
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
method: Warm the olive oil in a pan.
Add beans and a splash of water. Simmer for 8 minutes.

steps.title: A little preparation.
steps.body: Drain the cooked beans. Zest the lemon and chop the parsley.
steps.tip: Set the ingredients beside the stove before you begin.

steps.title: Warm the olive oil.
steps.body: Set a pan over medium-low heat. Add the olive oil and let it warm gently.
steps.tip: The oil should look glossy without smoking.

steps.title:
Let it gently
simmer.
steps.body: Add the beans and a splash of water. Cook until silky.
steps.tip: Stir gently. Add a little more water if the pan looks dry.

steps.title: Bring in the lemon.
steps.body: Take the pan off the heat. Stir in the lemon zest and a squeeze of juice.
steps.tip: Start with a little lemon juice, then taste and adjust.

steps.title: A fresh finish.
steps.body: Fold in the parsley. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
steps.tip: Keep a little parsley aside to scatter over the bowls.

steps.title: Make it a meal.
steps.body: Spoon into warm bowls and finish with a drizzle of olive oil.
steps.tip: Serve with a piece of toast if you have one.

tomato.title: Tomato & Burrata Pasta
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
method: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Halve 250 g cherry tomatoes, slice 2 garlic cloves, and pick a small handful of basil leaves.
Add 200 g pasta to the boiling water. Cook according to the package instructions until al dente. Reserve a mug of pasta water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, warm 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large pan over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and stir for about 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cherry tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened. Gently press some tomatoes to release their juices.
Add the drained pasta to the tomato pan. Toss with a splash of pasta water until the sauce coats the pasta. Tear in most of the basil, then turn off the heat.
Divide the pasta between two bowls. Tear 1 ball of burrata over the top and finish with the remaining basil and black pepper. Select Finish Cooking to review what you used.

steps.title: Prep your ingredients.
steps.body: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Halve 250 g cherry tomatoes, slice 2 garlic cloves, and pick a small handful of basil leaves.
steps.tip: Keep the burrata ready to add after cooking.

steps.title: Cook the pasta.
steps.body: Add 200 g pasta to the boiling water. Cook according to the package instructions until al dente. Reserve a mug of pasta water before draining.
steps.tip: The pasta should still have a little bite. Follow your pasta package for the timing.

steps.title: Warm the garlic.
steps.body: While the pasta cooks, warm 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large pan over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and stir for about 1 minute, until fragrant.
steps.tip: Lower the heat if the garlic starts to brown.

steps.title: Make the tomato sauce.
steps.body: Add the cherry tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened. Gently press some tomatoes to release their juices.
steps.tip: Add a splash of reserved pasta water if the pan looks dry.

steps.title: Toss it together.
steps.body: Add the drained pasta to the tomato pan. Toss with a splash of pasta water until the sauce coats the pasta. Tear in most of the basil, then turn off the heat.
steps.tip: Add pasta water a little at a time to keep the sauce silky.

steps.title: Add burrata and serve.
steps.body: Divide the pasta between two bowls. Tear 1 ball of burrata over the top and finish with the remaining basil and black pepper. Select Finish Cooking to review what you used.
steps.tip: Add burrata off the heat so its center stays creamy.
